name: swaps-wallet-screen
description: Check one public wallet address for available screening signals and see what the sources cover.

interface.longDescription: Paste a public blockchain address and choose a network. See available sanctions matches, previous screening signals, and the limits of the available data. No wallet connection required.

publication.release_notes: Refreshes the tool definition to the server's current output schema: a result can state that its screening was run live (coverage value live_screening) in addition to the existing values. Plugin information, skill and card are unchanged.

positive.prompt: Check the public Ethereum address 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD for risk signals.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the selected network and available screening result with a coverage statement. An inconclusive response never claims the address is safe.

positive.description: Use the explicitly requested EVM network
positive.prompt: Use Base to check 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD and tell me the coverage.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses Base and reports uncertainty if no assessment can be made. Does not fall back to Ethereum.

positive.prompt: Check this public Bitcoin address 1BoatSLRHtKNngkdXEeobR76b53LETtpyT for available risk signals.
positive.expected_behavior: Keeps the Bitcoin address case intact and returns the available screening result.

positive.prompt: Use Polygon to check the public address 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns coverage for Polygon or states the check was unavailable on that network.

positive.description: Reject an address format that does not match the network
positive.prompt: Check 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD specifically as a Bitcoin address.
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the address format mismatch and makes no claim about risk.

negative.description: A purchase and transfer are outside the screening scope
negative.prompt: Buy and send $100 of ETH for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to purchase or send ETH. No screening tool call or transactional link.

negative.description: A recovery phrase is a secret outside the screening inputs
negative.prompt: Can I paste my seed phrase so you can check my wallet?
negative.expected_behavior: Tells the user to keep the recovery phrase private and asks for only a public address and network.

negative.description: An address without a network requires clarification in a fresh conversation
negative.expected_behavior: Ask which network to use and wait. Do not call screen_wallet_address until the user supplies the network.
